audit.why: The packet chart (Yone, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Yone) matches the prose and the 57.19% win rate over 2787 games — Jax owns everything from level 2 to first item, and loses the two-item duel to crit plus the double-attack passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is written "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid.
audit.why: The ability is Grandmaster's Might, 110/100/90s; phases[4].why already uses the correct name.
audit.corrected: Renamed in all three. Spikes otherwise verified: Jax at 3, 6 and Trinity; Yone at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is the whole focus of this page and its cooldown is never given, and the page repeatedly treats Spirit Cleave as healing — mid says 'he has no Spirit Cleave heal', late says 'keep anti-heal up against his Spirit Cleave sustain', and the itemization and breakdown.late both make anti-heal core.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave grants a shield, not a heal — Riot's own text says 'Grants a shield to Yone', and the kit carries the shield flag with no heal flag. Grievous Wounds does nothing to it, so buying Executioner's Calling into Yone is wasted gold and a wasted item slot. Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 falling to 10s at rank 5, which is the actual timer the entire 'trade on his E cooldown' plan hangs on.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal advice removed from report[8].t and breakdown.late; the Spirit Cleave references in mid and late corrected to a shield. dosFull[0].d and whys[4] now name Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yone.json W text 'Grants a shield to Yone', shield flag, cd 14; E cd 22/19/16/13/10

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization tells you to rush Executioner's Calling 'because his healing fights your pattern'. Yone has no heal in his kit.
audit.why: Same root cause as above — the only sustain-shaped thing he has is Spirit Cleave's shield, which anti-heal does not touch.
audit.corrected: report[8].t rewritten to keep the Trinity/Sundered Sky/Steelcaps core and say explicitly that anti-heal does nothing here.

edits.before: This is your takeover. From 3 through 6 you own every extended trade because Counter Strike eats his Q-stack-and-autos pattern and stuns him before his Spirit Cleave shield matters. At 6, Grandmaster at Arms gives you the Armor/MR burst and the every-third on-hit, so the moment his E is down you Leap in, stun, and run him down — he has no Spirit Cleave heal that survives your R duel. Trade on his E cooldown specifically: when Soul Unbound is up he can rewind out, when it's down he's a melee duelist with no answer to your dodge-stun. Force the side lane and don't let him farm safely to crit items.
edits.after: This is your takeover. From 3 through 6 you own every extended trade because Counter Strike eats his Q-stack-and-autos pattern and stuns him before his 14s Spirit Cleave shield matters. At 6, Grandmaster's Might gives the Armor/MR burst and the every-third on-hit, so the moment his E is down you Leap in, stun, and run him down — that shield is absorption, not sustain, and it will not survive your R duel. Trade on his E specifically: 22s at rank 1, and while it is up he rewinds out; while it is down he is a melee duelist with no answer to your dodge-stun.

edits.before: You win the straight 1v1 all the way through your first item, but Yone is a hard scaler and that's the catch — once he has crit plus his double-attack-speed passive he becomes a mobile carry who Q-dashes out of your E radius and refuses the melee fight your stun needs. Past two items the math flips, so this lane is a race: press your level 3-6 lead, take plates and his tower, and end before his scaling overtakes your bruiser spike. Keep anti-heal up against his Spirit Cleave sustain, and in teamfights flank and stick to him rather than hoping to duel a fed Yone in the open.
edits.after: You win the straight 1v1 all the way through your first item, but Yone is a hard scaler and that's the catch — once he has crit plus his double-attack passive he becomes a mobile carry who Q-dashes out of your E radius and refuses the melee fight your stun needs. Past two items the math flips, so this lane is a race: press your level 3-6 lead, take plates and his tower, and end before his scaling overtakes your bruiser spike. Don't waste gold on anti-heal — Spirit Cleave is a shield, not a heal — and in teamfights flank and stick to him rather than duelling a fed Yone in the open.

notes: The biggest defect here was not the chart: four separate places told the reader to buy Grievous Wounds against a champion with no heal in his kit. Yone's W grants a shield (Riot's own text, shield flag, no heal flag) and nothing else in his kit heals, so Executioner's Calling was dead gold. Fixed in report[8].t, breakdown.late, mid and late. packet.suspectNames flags 'Hold Counter Strike' in wants.you[0] — false positive, that is Jax's real E name. Soul Unbound's 22s-to-10s range is now on the page; note the gap shrinks by more than half as he ranks it, so the 'trade on his E cooldown' plan is far weaker at rank 5 than the page implies — worth a future line.
